title: Cross-Section Estimation of Long-Run Relations Using Time-Compressed Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.25901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many empirical investigations of long-run relations are based on cross-section regressions in averaged or long differenced data that effectively have the time dimension of a $T\times N$ panel compressed. We analyze a class of time-compressed I(1) data and show that they have magnified variability stemming from the fact that the cross-section variance of a non-stationary panel `fans out' with time. Cross-section regressions in time compressed data can potentially yield estimates that are super-consistent and asymptotically normal, whether the regressors are stationary, non-stationary, or highly persistent. The fastest convergence rate of $\sqrt{N}T$ requires a compression scheme that not only magnifies the non-stationary signal, but also dilutes the regression noise. translated_title: 基于时间压缩数据的长期关系截面估计
translated_abstract: 摘要：许多关于长期关系的实证研究基于平均或长期差分数据的截面回归，这些数据实际上将$T\times N$面板的时间维度进行了压缩。我们分析了一类时间压缩的I(1)数据，并表明它们具有放大的变异性，这是因为非平稳面板的截面方差随时间“扇形展开”。在时间压缩数据中进行截面回归，无论回归变量是平稳、非平稳还是高度持久的，都可能产生超一致且渐近正态的估计。最快的收敛速率$\sqrt{N}T$要求压缩方案不仅放大非平稳信号，还要稀释回归噪声。省略固定效应会阻碍噪声稀释，但估计仍保持超一致性。然而，当数据存在强持久性力量时，扇形展开效应可能会被削弱。
tldr: 本文提出时间压缩数据可放大非平稳信号并稀释噪声，使截面回归获得超一致且渐近正态的估计，收敛速率可达$\sqrt{N}T$。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that time-compressed data can amplify non-stationary signals and dilute noise, enabling cross-section regressions to achieve super-consistent and asymptotically normal estimates with a convergence rate of $\sqrt{N}T$.
